{{Quote|Opening priority channel "indigo seven". I'm receiving your transmission.|Satele Shan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Indigo seven''' was a secure communication channel used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Satele Shan]] contacted the strike team ready to engage into the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] war games from [[Carrick Station]] on this channel.
